Situation

A steady packaging business

Revenue grew every year and margin held while input prices fell. The business has refinanced twice without a covenant reset and carries no history of a missed payment.

Complication

The add-on carries the case

Pro forma EBITDA leans on the add-on before the quality of earnings report closes, so the leverage figure rests on numbers nobody has yet verified.

Resolution

Approve with conditions

Fund once the report closes and the year-to-date actuals hold against budget. If neither arrives, the request returns to committee unchanged.
